definition_ja: 対立仮説が「μ ≠ μ₀」のように両方向の違いを考え、棄却域を分布の両側にとる検定。
definition_en: A test whose alternative hypothesis allows a difference in either direction (such as μ ≠ μ₀), with the rejection region split between both tails.

examples.en: It's two-tailed, so we double the one-tail area to get the p-value.
examples.ja: 両側検定なので、片側の面積を 2 倍して p 値にする。

examples.en: Perform a two-tailed test at the 1% significance level.
examples.ja: 有意水準 1% で両側検定を行え。

pitfalls: 形容詞で The test is two-tailed. とも言う（OpenStax Introductory Statistics、two-tailed 単独を含めると 41 件）。
